description: Inspect upload or durable package processing status: queued, processing, failed, completed. Poll every few seconds until completed before claiming publication succeeded; completed includes result and URL. Tasks survive disconnects and server restarts. Recovery expires after six hours.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

upload_id.description: Upload session versionId returned by upload_start.
